title: Surreal Vortex Landscape
description: A surreal desert scene features rolling orange sand dunes in the foreground leading toward a massive central spiral vortex. The vortex contains concentric rings of purple, pink, and teal with a glowing orb at its core, flanked by two antler-like structures and a white pyramid shape below. In the upper portion, a large cracked celestial body with green and yellow tones floats against swirling cosmic patterns and faint alchemical symbols.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with flowing orange sand dunes in foreground, leading to a giant swirling vortex spiral in the center composed of concentric rings in purple, pink and teal. A small glowing orb floats at the vortex core with a white pyramid shape beneath it. Two large cracked antler-like structures emerge from the vortex. A large cracked celestial body with green and yellow hues floats in the upper right against a dark cosmic background filled with swirling patterns and faint alchemical symbols.
